errorCodes.meaning: The caller has an open report of this event. Nothing was stored; the open report's identifier is in `details`.
The caller has filed as many reports as the community allows in a day. Nothing was stored.

EventId.description: Opaque identifier of an event: `evt_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-EVT-001).
EventId.title: EventId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ReportId.description: Opaque identifier of one member's report of an event: `rpt_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters.
ReportId.title: ReportId

ReportReason.description: `inappropriate`: content or conduct the community does not accept. `spam`: an event that is advertising or noise. `unsafe`: an event that puts people at risk. `misleading`: an event that is not what it says. `other`: the note says.
ReportReason.title: ReportReason

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/report/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/report/0.1#response.

schema.description: A member reports an event they may see to the community's administrators: inappropriate, spam, unsafe, misleading, or something else, with an optional note. The report goes on the administrators' action list; who reported is visible to administrators only. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

note.description: What the administrators should know. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.

schema.title: VTC Events — Report — payload
